rb-frr.label: IPL run rate in overs 11–15 when 0–1 down at halfway
rb-frr.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
rb-frr.query: WITH st AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.over_num < 10 GROUP BY d.innings_id), nx AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(d.total_runs) r, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.over_num BETWEEN 10 AND 14 GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN st.wk <= 1 THEN '0–1 down' WHEN st.wk <= 3 THEN '2–3 down' ELSE '4+ down' END state, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, SUM(nx.r) * 6.0 / SUM(nx.b) rr, SUM(nx.w) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) wkts, COUNT(*) n FROM st JOIN nx ON nx.innings_id = st.innings_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = st.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY state, side
